args.description: A merchant's covered wagon on a transparent background, seen from high above at a steep angle. Pale canvas tilt stretched over curved hoops, dark timber body, four spoked wooden wheels, a draught horse in harness at the front, small crates roped on behind. No ground, no road, no sky.

args.description: A single armoured knight standing on foot, on a transparent background, seen from high above at a steep angle so the helm and shoulders read first. Full steel plate armour, a crimson surcoat, a kite shield on the left arm and a sword held at the right side. No ground, no grass, no sky.
